name: career-coach-local
description: Evidence-led resume coaching and source-backed job research for your local career platform.

interface.shortDescription: Review your experience and target suitable jobs
interface.longDescription: Reuse Reactive Resume's career skills and the local evidence interview. Keep learning goals separate from experience, review market sources, and prepare truthful documents. Connects only to your loopback career app; application submission requires its own policy.
defaultPrompt: Review my resume with an evidence interview.
Research the requirements for my target roles.
